The *Aññatarātherīgāthā* (Thig 1.1) is the opening poem of the *Therīgāthā*, located in the Khuddaka Nikāya of the Pali Sutta Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. As indicated by its title, the text consists of a single verse attributed to an unnamed elder nun (*aññatarā therī*), translated by Bhikkhu Sujato under the English title "An Unnamed Nun (1st)" [SuttaCentral].

In modern scholarship and dissemination, the poem is cataloged on SuttaCentral with 18 translations across 12 languages, including English translations by Bhikkhu Sujato, Ayya Soma, and Thanissaro Bhikkhu [SuttaCentral]. The secondary literature excerpts retrieved in the dossier do not directly address this particular text, representing accidental matches on the common Pali indefinite pronoun *aññatara* / *aññatarā* ("a certain") in Vinaya, Sutta, and Jātaka narratives.

With respect to parallels and text reuse, SuttaCentral records no curated parallels in Chinese, Sanskrit, Tibetan, or other canonical collections [SuttaCentral]. In agreement with this, automated analysis by DharmaNexus identified no instances of Pali-internal text reuse and no cross-language matches meeting the alignment threshold [DharmaNexus].
